content.src: 车内的气味显然并不好闻，这也难怪本应只能乘做十几人的车厢挤进了近三十名孩童
content.target: The smell inside the car was obviously not pleasant, which was no surprise since the carriage, meant for just over a dozen people, was packed with nearly thirty children.

content.src: 虽说小孩块头比成年人小很多，但仍使车内拥挤不堪
content.target: Although children are much smaller than adults, the car was still extremely crowded.

content.src: 韩立机灵的把瘦弱的身子缩到车厢内的边角里，偷偷的打量着车内的其他孩童
content.target: Han Li cleverly squeezed his thin body into a corner of the carriage and secretly observed the other children.

content.src: 来参加入门考查的孩童从衣着打扮，从出身上看明显分为了三类人
content.target: The children coming for the entrance test were clearly divided into three groups based on their clothing and background.

content.src: 第一类人是坐在车厢正中，正被其余大部分孩童簇拥其中的锦衣少年这一类人
content.target: The first group was the richly dressed boy sitting in the center of the carriage, surrounded by most of the other children.

content.src: 这名少年叫舞岩，今年十三岁，是车内年龄最大的一人
content.target: This boy was named Wu Yan, thirteen years old, the oldest in the carriage.

content.src: 本来年龄已过了规定，但其有一表姐嫁给七玄门内的一名掌权人物，年龄问题自然也就不成问题了
content.target: He was technically too old to qualify, but his cousin had married a powerful figure in the Seven Mysteries Sect, so his age was no longer an issue.

content.src: 舞岩家开了一间武馆，家中颇为富裕，还自小练了一些拳脚功夫，虽然并不怎吗高明，但对付象韩立这样只有一些笨力气并从未习过武的小孩，还是绰绰有余
content.target: Wu Yan's family ran a martial arts school and was quite wealthy. He had practiced some basic martial arts since childhood. Though not highly skilled, he was more than capable of handling kids like Han Li, who only had raw strength and no training.

content.src: 很显然像舞岩这类人，家里有钱又有势，还会几手功夫，自然就自的成为了车内大部分孩童的“大哥”
content.target: Naturally, someone like Wu Yan—wealthy, influential, and with some martial arts skills—easily became the 'big brother' to most children in the carriage.

content.src: 另一类人就是簇拥着舞岩的这些孩童，这部分人出身五花八门，家里有开店铺的，有打工的，有靠手艺吃饭的……等等，但都有同一个特点就是：都是在城镇中长大的，自然或多或少的跟家里大人学会了一些察颜观色，逐利而行的本事，因此这些人都簇拥着舞岩，并左一声“舞少爷”右一声“舞大哥”的称呼着，舞岩看起来对此早以习以为常，非常的受用这些称呼
content.target: The second group consisted of the children surrounding Wu Yan. They came from various backgrounds—shopkeepers, laborers, craftsmen, etc.—but all shared one trait: they grew up in towns and had learned, to some extent, how to read situations and seek advantage. Thus, they crowded around Wu Yan, calling him 'Young Master Wu' or 'Brother Wu.' Wu Yan seemed very used to and pleased by these titles.

content.src: 最后一类人就是韩立这类人，这类人都来自偏僻的穷乡僻壤，家里一般都是靠山吃山，靠水吃水，非常的穷苦
content.target: The last group of people were like Han Li, all from remote and poor villages. Their families usually lived off the land or water, and they were very poor.

content.src: 这类人在车里是最少的了，只有五六人，神态多半畏手畏脚不敢大声言语，只是看别人放声说笑，和不时大声喧闹的那部分童子形成了鲜明的对比
content.target: There were very few of these people in the carriage, only five or six. They were timid and afraid to speak loudly, just watching others laugh and talk, forming a sharp contrast with the noisy children.

content.src: 马车从青牛镇出一路向西飞奔，路途中又去了好几个地方，又接了几个孩童，终于在第五天傍晚时分赶到了彩霞山，七玄门总门所在地
content.target: The carriage left Qingniu Town and sped westward, stopping at several places to pick up more children. Finally, on the evening of the fifth day, it arrived at Caixia Mountain, the headquarters of the Seven Mysteries Sect.

content.src: 所有的孩子一下车，都被彩霞山那五彩的落日美景深深的迷住了，直到王护法催促声起，大家才清醒过来继续往前走
content.target: As soon as the children got off the carriage, they were deeply enchanted by the colorful sunset scenery of Caixia Mountain. It wasn’t until Protector Wang urged them that they snapped out of it and continued forward.

content.src: 彩霞山原名落凤山，相传古时一头五色彩凤落在此地，化成此山
content.target: Caixia Mountain was originally called Luofeng Mountain. Legend says that a colorful phoenix once landed here and turned into this mountain.

content.src: 后由于来此的人现此山在落日时分美丽异常，犹如彩霞笼罩，又被人改为彩霞山
content.target: Later, people who came here found the mountain exceptionally beautiful at sunset, as if covered in colorful clouds, so they renamed it Caixia Mountain.

content.src: 当然此山自从被七玄门占有后，外人自然不能再来此随意欣赏如此美景
content.target: Of course, since the Seven Mysteries Sect took over the mountain, outsiders could no longer freely enjoy such beauty.

content.src: 彩霞山是镜州境内第二大山，除了另一座百莽山，就数此山占地最广，方圆十几里内都是此山的山脉所在
content.target: Caixia Mountain is the second-largest mountain in Jingzhou. Apart from another mountain called Baimang Mountain, it covers the widest area, spanning over ten miles in radius.

content.src: 此山拥有大大小小的山峰十几个，各个都十分险要，因此全都被七玄门各个分堂所占据
content.target: The mountain has more than ten peaks of various sizes, all very steep, so each is occupied by a different branch of the Seven Mysteries Sect.

content.src: 彩霞山的主峰“落日峰”更是险恶无比，不但奇高陡峭，而且从山底到峰顶只有一条路可走，七玄门将总堂便放在此处后，又在这条路险要之处，一连设下了十三处或明或暗的哨卡，可称的上是万无一失，高枕无忧
content.target: The main peak of Caixia Mountain, 'Sunset Peak,' is extremely dangerous. Not only is it unusually high and steep, but there is only one path from the base to the summit. After placing their headquarters here, the Seven Mysteries Sect set up thirteen hidden and visible checkpoints along this path, making it nearly foolproof and worry-free.

content.src: 韩立边打量着四周边跟着前边的人向前走，忽然前头的队伍停了下来，接着传来一声豪爽的话语声
content.target: Han Li looked around as he followed the person in front, when suddenly the line ahead stopped, followed by a hearty voice.

content.src: “王老弟，怎么才到
content.target: "Brother Wang, why are you so late?

content.src: 可比预定时间晚了两天
content.target: You're two days behind schedule.

content.src:
”

“岳堂主，路上耽搁了些时间，老烦您老费心了
content.target:
"

"Hall Master Yue, we were delayed on the road. Sorry to trouble you."

content.src: ”王护法站在人群前，恭敬的向一位红脸的老者施了一礼，一改路上一直的跋扈神色，脸上露出几分媚色
content.target: Guardian Wang stood in front of the crowd, bowing respectfully to a red-faced elder, his usual arrogance replaced by a flattering expression.

content.src: “这是第几批送到山上的弟子了
content.target: "How many groups of disciples have been sent up the mountain?

content.src:
”

“第十七批人了
content.target:
"

"The seventeenth group."

"

"Hmm."

content.src: ”这位岳堂主大模大样的看了几眼韩立他们
content.target: Hall Master Yue glanced at Han Li and the others with an air of importance.

content.src: “送到清客院，让他们好好休息一晚，明天一早就开始选拔合格弟子
content.target: "Take them to the Guest House for a good night's rest. The selection of qualified disciples will begin tomorrow morning."

content.src: 没过关的，及早让他们下山，免的犯了山上的规矩
content.target: Those who fail should go down the mountain early to avoid breaking the mountain's rules.

content.src:
”

“遵命，岳堂主
content.target: "Understood, Hall Master Yue."

content.src:
”

走在上山的石阶上，所有的小孩都兴奋不已，但没有人敢大声说话，虽然众人年纪都不大，却都知道这里就是决定自己未来命运的地方
content.target: Walking up the stone steps of the mountain, all the children were excited, but no one dared to speak loudly. Though they were young, they all knew this was the place that would decide their future.

content.src: 王护法一边在前面带路，一边面带微笑的与路上遇到的人打着招呼，可以看的出他在门内熟人很多，人缘不错
content.target: Guardian Wang led the way with a smile, greeting people he met along the path. It was clear he had many friends in the sect and was well-liked.

content.src: 一路遇到的人大都身穿青缎衣，身上或挎着刀，或背着剑，偶尔一些赤授空拳的人腰间也鼓鼓囊囊的，不知揣着升吗东西，从行为举止上，可以看出这些人身手矫健，都有一身不错的功夫在身
content.target: Most people they met wore dark satin clothes, carrying knives or swords. A few had nothing in their hands, but their waists bulged with unknown items. Their movements showed they were agile and skilled in martial arts.

content.src: 韩立等人被带到一座较矮的山峰上，山顶有一片土房，在这里韩立等人住了一宿
content.target: Han Li and the others were taken to a shorter mountain peak, where a cluster of earthen houses stood. They spent the night there.

content.src: 在晚上的睡梦中，韩立在梦里梦到自己身穿锦衣，手拿金剑，身怀绝世武功，把村里自己一直都打不过的铁匠的儿子痛打了一顿，好不威风，直到第二天早上起来仍回味不已
content.target: That night, Han Li dreamed of wearing fine clothes, holding a golden sword, and possessing unmatched martial skills. He beat up the blacksmith's son, whom he could never defeat in the village, feeling very proud. He kept savoring the dream even after waking up the next morning.

content.src: 早上起来后，王护法并没有让大家吃早饭，直接把众人带到山下的一大片种满竹子的斜坡跟前
content.target: In the morning, Guardian Wang didn’t let them eat breakfast. Instead, he took them directly to a large bamboo-covered slope at the mountain's base.

content.src: 在那里，昨天已见过的姓岳的堂主和其他几位不认识的年青人已等在那里
content.target: There, Hall Master Yue, whom they had met the day before, and a few unfamiliar young men were already waiting.
